title: Superhuman hero carousel
description: A split hero: near-black on the left half, maroon on the right. A big two-tone headline (grey lead, bright product name), a lilac button and a lilac link, and at the bottom a 'toolkit' list of product rows. The media sits in the right half, cropped to the section; on phones it moves below the buttons and the rows become a three-cell switcher. Every 10 seconds the next product dissolves in (500ms) while a thin progress line fills on its row; hovering a row sweeps a faint white wash.
notes: deep surface: left half uses chart-5, right half chart-2, text uses primary-foreground; best on the Superhuman theme
auto-advances every 10s; with reduced motion it stays on the chosen product
the media is a screenshot or video slot; empty shows a colour-wash placeholder
name: superhuman-hero
